structuredContent.name: parties.list-parties
structuredContent.description: List visible parties in the envelope tenant, ordered by normalized display name then PartyId. Filters apply before paging and totals exclude erased parties. Use envelope paging: default size 20 and offset 0, maximum size 100, page-aligned offsets or a scoped continuation cursor. To continue, supply the returned paging.nextCursor without offset, keeping the same query, filters, envelope tenant, user and page size.

Type.description: Optional party kind: Person or Organization; Unknown and other values reject. Applied before paging.

Active.description: Optional active-status filter, applied before paging; omitted includes active and inactive parties.

CreatedAfter.description: Inclusive earliest creation instant, with an explicit UTC or numeric offset; omitted leaves this bound open. Each lower bound must not exceed its upper bound.

CreatedBefore.description: Inclusive latest creation instant, with an explicit UTC or numeric offset; omitted leaves this bound open. Each lower bound must not exceed its upper bound.

ModifiedAfter.description: Inclusive earliest modification instant, with an explicit UTC or numeric offset; omitted leaves this bound open. Each lower bound must not exceed its upper bound.

ModifiedBefore.description: Inclusive latest modification instant, with an explicit UTC or numeric offset; omitted leaves this bound open. Each lower bound must not exceed its upper bound.
